== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns John Wallace. The 1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory lists John Wallace as a teacher at Lisnagaver in the neighbourhood inhabitants section for Rasharkin. It adds a contemporary local associate to the Lisnagaver network, but no evidence currently connects John Wallace to Nancy Glasgow's nephew Robert Wallace Anderson or to the Glasgow family.<ref>1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory, Rasharkin; [https://lennonwylie.co.uk/PT191214.htm record].</ref> The directory gives no age, address beyond Lisnagaver or relationship. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns John Wallace. The original 1911 Lisnagaver return identifies John Wallace, 55, National School Teacher born County Derry, with Antrim-born wife Mary Anne, 52; married 26 years, seven children born and six living. Their six resident children are Mary H, William G, James G, Samuel G, Sarah G and Letitia C. This strongly identifies the 1912 directory teacher.<ref>1911 Lisnagaver, John Wallace household; [https://api-census.nationalarchives.ie/census/image/nai001389399.pdf record].</ref> The identification remains uncertain.
